title: Otter.ai vs Fireflies.ai: which to pick
meta_description: Otter.ai vs Fireflies.ai, compared on official facts: free plan limits, real prices, bot and bot-free recording, languages and privacy, with our verdict.
summary: Pick Otter.ai if you want a free plan that renews every month and the cheaper paid plan ($8.33 a month billed yearly). Pick Fireflies.ai if your meetings run long or you need more than Otter's six languages. Both can record without a bot from their desktop apps, and their AI-training policies differ; see below.

sections.heading: Free plans: which goes further
body: Otter.ai's free plan renews every month, but it is built for short calls: each conversation shows only its first 30 minutes of transcript, and only your 25 most recent conversations stay visible. Upgrade and the archived ones come back.

Fireflies.ai's free plan handles longer meetings (up to 2 hours), but its 400 minutes are a storage cap, not a monthly allowance. Once you hit it, you have to delete old meetings to open new ones. That makes it a good trial and a poor long-term free option.

facts.text: Otter.ai Basic: 300 minutes a month, 30 minutes per conversation, 25 most recent conversations visible
Fireflies.ai Free: 400 minutes of storage per team, 2-hour recording limit, 20 AI credits

sections.heading: Recording with or without a bot
body: By default, both send a notetaker bot into Zoom, Google Meet and Microsoft Teams calls, and other people in the call can see it. Both also offer a Mac and Windows desktop app that records from your computer's audio instead, with no bot in the call.
Fireflies.ai's bot-free desktop mode keeps only the transcript and summary, not an audio or video file. Its Chrome extension can also record Google Meet without the bot.

facts.text: Otter.ai desktop app records without a bot on Mac and Windows
Fireflies.ai desktop app records without a bot; transcript and summary only

sections.heading: What you pay
body: For one paying user, Otter.ai is cheaper: Pro is $8.33 a month billed yearly against Fireflies.ai's $10, and $16.99 against $18 month to month. Otter's Pro adds 1,200 minutes a month and meetings up to 90 minutes; Fireflies.ai's Pro removes the transcription and summary limits but keeps a 2-hour recording cap.
At the Business level the two cost about the same. Fireflies.ai's Enterprise plan is $39 per seat, billed yearly only; Otter.ai doesn't publish an Enterprise price.

facts.text: Otter.ai Pro: 1,200 minutes a month per user, up to 90 minutes per meeting
Fireflies.ai Pro: unlimited transcription and summaries, 8,000 minutes of storage per seat, 2-hour recording limit

sections.heading: Languages and privacy
body: Otter.ai transcribes six languages. If your meetings happen in Portuguese, Italian or anything else outside that list, Fireflies.ai is the only one of the two that will work, though it labels most non-English languages as beta.

The two describe their AI training differently. According to Otter.ai's privacy and security policy (checked Oct 2026), Otter trains its own models on user data after removing identifying details, and its third-party AI providers do not train on customer data. According to Fireflies.ai's pricing page (checked Oct 2026), customer data is never used for AI training. Read both policies against your own rules. Both offer HIPAA only on their enterprise tiers.

facts.text: According to Otter.ai's policy (checked Oct 2026): trains its own models on de-identified user data; third-party AI providers do not train on customer data
According to Fireflies.ai's pricing page (checked Oct 2026): customer data is never used for AI training
Otter.ai: HIPAA is an Enterprise add-on

verdict.heading: Our verdict
body: For a single person who mostly has short calls in English, Otter.ai is the better deal: its free plan renews monthly and its paid plan costs less.

For teams with long meetings or several languages, Fireflies.ai is the stronger pick, but budget for a paid plan, because its free storage runs out. If AI training matters to you, read each company's policy, linked above.
